vulnerabilities.title: Prototype Pollution in sheetJS
vulnerabilities.evidence_of_no_fix: pnpm audit returns patched_versions: null AND patched_versions_unpublished: true
vulnerabilities.required_action: Cannot be closed by upgrading from npm. Requires replacing the library, vendoring the official SheetJS CDN build with integrity verification, or a formal written risk acceptance. Supply-chain approval needed.

backend.exit_code_note: govulncheck exits 3 when vulnerabilities are found; exit 0 on the -format json run because that invocation emits the machine-readable stream. Both are real scan products (732 KB JSON, 12 OSV-linked findings), not install logs.
backend.govulncheck_own_summary: Your code is affected by 3 vulnerabilities from 3 modules. This scan also found 5 vulnerabilities in packages you import and 4 vulnerabilities in modules you require, but your code doesn't appear to call these vulnerabilities.
backend.severity_resolution_method: vuln.go.dev Go records carry NO severity field. Severity was resolved by fetching each GHSA alias from https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/<GHSA-ID> (OSV mirrors GHSA severity). 4 x/crypto advisories have no GHSA alias and OSV returns no severity -> recorded UNKNOWN, never guessed.
